scope: mix wotex.software.build and mix wotex.software.run inside Linux arm64 containers on both required Elixir/OTP runtimes, with the Linux ASan/UBSan native vector build, the independent Californium cohort and owner-loss reaping of guarded peers

source_identity.kind: repository working tree whose packages equal the named commit, copied into each container

environment.platform: Linux arm64 (container VM on macOS arm64)
environment.container: docker run --rm --cpus 4 --memory 6g, both lanes concurrently; read-only mount of the repository; rsync of packages/wotex, packages/wotex-runtime and packages/wotex-coap to /work/src/packages excluding _build, deps, cover, doc and archives; WOTEX_PATH_DEPS=1 TMPDIR=/work/tmp

defects_found.observed: One receiver-death cycle of the OSCORE lifecycle stress test left the libcoap peer's observer in place (152 created, 151 removed)
defects_found.fixed_by: commit 40c9c0f7: the native worker handles custody's SIGTERM and still sends its exit cancellation; see native-worker-terminated-v1.json

defects_found.observed: The first runs failed with peer_processes_retained 1: the lane's own sh -c wrapper, process 1 of the container, named workspace files in its arguments
defects_found.fixed_by: commit 160bcc38: the count excludes the run's own BEAM and its ancestors up to and including process 1

retained.assertion_source: process table after the suite for peer processes; interop peer owners for ports, sessions, contexts, subscriptions and store locks
process table after the suite for peer processes; interop peer owners for ports, sessions, contexts, subscriptions and store locks

assertions: Both lanes build the pinned libcoap with its ten ordered patches, the production helper, the upstream coap-server peer and 12 native fault/vector executables; every vector compiles with ASan/UBSan and exits 0, including the production-worker exchange harness
The production helper and peer binaries are byte-identical across the two lanes

Both lanes run the 15 independent UDP/PSK/PKI tests, 12 same-stack OSCORE tests, 5 independent Californium OSCORE tests on OpenJDK 17, 8 lifecycle stress tests, 13 native-v1 corpus tests, 2 saturation tests and 2 peer guardian tests with seed zero, 57 passes each
Each software run measures zero live processes naming a workspace file after the suite and records zero retained command groups, UDP ports and session/context/subscription/store locks
unaccepted: The production helper used by the ExUnit OSCORE, corpus and stress cases is not itself sanitizer-instrumented in this lane; the separately sanitized helper remains the test/native/Dockerfile evidence
Linux x86_64, other distributions and other toolchains
Group OSCORE, OSCORE context re-derivation and a second independent OSCORE stack
